g.text: Figure 333: UUID Data Representation, Endianness & Wire Format Translation
Structural Mapping: Canonical RFC 4122 vs SOF Registry vs Little-Endian Memory vs ALSA Topology 2 vs Linux Kernel GUID
1. STRING FORMAT COMPARISON (RFC 4122 CANONICAL vs SOF REGISTRY)
Standard 5-group hex notation emitted by Linux uuidgen and Python uuid.uuid4()
Fourth hyphen omitted: matches uint8_t d[8] contiguous byte array in struct sof_uuid
2. FIRMWARE C DATA STRUCTURE: struct sof_uuid (include/sof/lib/uuid.h)
3. PHYSICAL MEMORY & WIRE SERIALIZATION (16 BYTES IN LITTLE-ENDIAN DSP / HOST MEMORY)
Notice that 0x8b9d100c is stored as 0c:10:9d:8b, 0x6d78 as 78:6d, and 0x418f as 8f:41.
The final 8 bytes d[0..7] are stored in verbatim order (90 a3 e0 e8 05 d0 85 2b) without reversal.
• Loadable library file named via kasprintf
• Dispatched to DSP via IPC4 library load
